text: The sun rises in the east. This is an original demonstration sentence for tokenizer and gradient-flow testing. Python functions can accept parameters and return values. This toy dataset is not a useful knowledge corpus. The model learns next byte prediction and must not be assessed as a general assistant. Each evaluation uses held-out windows from this demonstration text.

A compiler checks source code and can report syntax errors. The purpose of this tiny local training run is only to validate the training machinery, checkpoint persistence and generation without external weights. It is not enough to learn real software engineering or conversation skills. Dedicated curated licensed data is necessary for useful training.
